# Prime Agent fixtures

Independently authored synthetic Prime Agent sessions. They exercise the
public FAD contract. They are **not** copies of Prime Agent tests or any
private `~/.prime` session.

Do not commit real prompts, paths, IDs, environment values, tool output,
API metadata, or image data.
